name: auro-ai
description: Claude Code plugins for the Auro design system and auro-formkit workflows.

plugins.name: auro
plugins.description: Skills for Auro repositories: commit (guided Conventional Commits workflow), code-review (multi-model PR/local review with doc-review and coding-standards passes), release-notes (release-notes generation from Conventional Commits), pr (PR creation with prompted base/draft, component labels, and post-mortem summaries and Discussion links), ado (Azure DevOps work-item drafting), post-mortem (post-mortem authoring with GitHub Discussions publishing), doc-review, close-dependabot, create-rcs, sprint-report, coding-standards (read-only Auro coding standards that apply themselves during code work without being summoned), capture-standard (turns a release's post-mortems into proposed coding-standards rules), and release-prep (runs capture-standard and release-notes as an rc branch merges into main).
